behavioral_description: Stable underdog: consistently priced below 25%, resolved NO ~86% of the time. Low volatility (0.040), almost no time near 50% (2%). Outcome was largely anticipated from market open.
Strong late-converging favorite: started near 50/50, resolved YES ~84% of the time with a large intraday range (0.73) and decisive final-day move (+0.48 in 24h).

Volatile near-miss underdog: spent 46% of lifetime near 50% before resolving NO ~84% of the time. Large range (0.59), strong late-day drift (-0.29 in 24h). These markets appeared contested before the crowd shifted decisively toward NO.
Long-duration markets (~14 days open). Dominant type: series_outcome. Low short-term volatility (0.046); final prob=0.33; YES rate=27%.
